summary: The current Dimer soft Force/Torque residuals are hash-bound and accepted only for diagnostic local-frequency handoff; a reviewed seven-atom partial-Hessian structure is prepared locally and no frequency VASP job is authorized or submitted.

payload.objective: Prepare and validate the contract-defined local partial-Hessian frequency input for Fe(110) C* + H* -> CH* + * while preserving the diagnostic-only acceptance boundary.
current_evidence: The user accepted the current DIMCAR Force 0.07983 eV/A and Torque 0.13710 eV/A residuals only for local-frequency validation.
The hash-bound Dimer soft review decision is allow_frequency_handoff: frequency_handoff_allowed=true and ts_validation_eligible=false.
The local active set was recomputed from the final Dimer CONTCAR as zero-based Fe32, Fe37, Fe41, Fe43, Fe44, C45, and H46: the reaction atoms plus every movable Fe within 2.50 A of C45 or H46.
The prepared frequency POSCAR exposes exactly those seven atoms as T T T and keeps all other atoms F F F.
The VFA handoff records submitted=false, Grade=Ungraded, and database_eligible=false; no frequency calculation has run.
payload.one_executable_step: Build and audit the compatible local-frequency VASP inputs and execution gate, then obtain explicit user authorization before submission.
payload.submission_boundary: No new VASP job is authorized. Do not submit the local-frequency calculation, claim a validated TS, assign Grade A, or report a barrier from this handoff.
done_when: A compatible local partial-Hessian VASP job is explicitly authorized, submitted, and reaches normal/electronic completion.
Canonical frequency analysis finds exactly one accepted imaginary mode dominated by the intended C45-H46 reaction coordinate with no disqualifying secondary modes.
Compatible IS/TS/FS final OUTCAR TOTEN values are separately reviewed before any electronic barrier is reported.
